reference_material: All references, Git IDs and digest strings are dummy shape values. No referenced byte store is supplied or digest-established here. A schema-valid document may be semantically invalid. None of these examples is an installed production or synthetic context. The separate future test harness must construct and pin a complete immutable fixture bundle and recompute its byte references before accepting queries.
validator_contract: Draft 2020-12 with format checking. Reject duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite numbers before schema validation. Validate each case against the named local $def, not the top-level record union for component cases. The validation environment must actually implement the date-time format check; if jsonschema optional RFC3339 support is absent, use an explicit standard-library datetime calendar/timezone checker in the ephemeral validation driver. A no-op format checker is not validation.
